targeted_semantic_reviews.summary: Methods use sLDSC baseline-LD2.2 with European reference/HapMap3 regression SNPs, MHC exclusion, supplied peak annotations and additional conditioning. The current catalog omits this family role; canonical correction remains pending. The new univariate method does not supply this role.
RELI is presented as an alternative to stratified LD-score regression; this paragraph does not establish LDSC execution. Correct canonical role attribution in a later source-bound transition.
Discussion lists LD-score regression among possible correlation methods, while the study used a simple Z-score method. This is not an execution omission.

scope: Canonical source-pointer census with four targeted semantic reviews, not a recall-complete family extraction or canonical correction. Native prepared unpartitioned Hsq numerical component. Census does not establish that every mention uses Hsq or resolve genetic correlation, stratification, LD-score generation, historical editions or whole author pipelines.
